hero_sub: A practical AI roadmap for Capones USA that turns new product inquiries, appointment and consultation booking, customer support, and follow-up into a faster, more consistent operating workflow.

hero_stats.label: Team members the workflow has to support
AI agents mapped to your first workflow layer

profile_note: This roadmap is built from your Blueprint AI intake for Capones USA and your public site. You reported a five-person team, a $10M+ revenue band, roughly ten new leads a month, no CRM in place yet, a sixty-minute response target, and appointment booking as your biggest operational stress area, with more leads as your top goal. Because the deeper details come from your form and site, the plan stays conservative and keeps human review on pricing, fulfillment, and customer-sensitive decisions.

results.title: Capones USA can turn inquiries and bookings into a managed operating system
results.sub: The first Blueprint layer should not promise magic. It should reduce repeated manual steps across new inquiries, appointment booking, customer support, and follow-up, while keeping human review on pricing, fulfillment, and customer-sensitive decisions.

cards.title: Faster first response
cards.desc: You aim to respond within an hour. AI can acknowledge every new inquiry immediately and gather the context your team needs before a human reply.

cards.title: Easier appointment booking
cards.desc: Appointment booking is your biggest stress area today. AI can offer times, confirm details, and reduce the back-and-forth that slows scheduling down.

cards.title: More leads captured
cards.desc: Your top goal is more leads. A reliable intake-and-follow-up system makes sure interested customers and buyers do not slip through the cracks.

results.close: The practical opportunity for Capones USA is faster response, easier booking, and cleaner follow-up without adding another heavy platform.

pillars.title: Revenue Capture
pillars.sub: Reduce the gap between a new inquiry and a useful response so fewer leads go cold.

pillars.title: Time Recovery
pillars.sub: Move routine intake, booking, summaries, and follow-up into agent-assisted workflows.

pillars.title: Operational Consistency
pillars.sub: Give every customer and buyer conversation the same next-action discipline across your team.

gaps.title: New inquiries need faster routing
gaps.desc: You target a sixty-minute response. The first operational win is making sure product, support, and wholesale requests are acknowledged and classified immediately.

gaps.title: Appointment booking is the biggest stress point
gaps.desc: You named booking as your top stress area. AI can offer available times, confirm details, and send reminders so scheduling stops eating your team's time.

gaps.title: There is no CRM holding the pipeline together
gaps.desc: You reported no CRM today. Conversations spread across email, WhatsApp, and chat lose context. A light system can capture every lead and its next action.

gaps.title: Follow-up should be consistent
gaps.desc: With roughly ten leads a month and more leads as your goal, every one matters. AI can keep follow-up moving without unapproved pricing or fulfillment promises.

oppmap.impact: Every new product, support, or wholesale inquiry gets a useful response and a clear next step instead of waiting in the inbox.
Booking and consultation requests get offered times, confirmation, and reminders without manual back-and-forth.
You can prioritize the right conversations without reading every message from scratch.
Order and product questions become easier to route and resolve.
Interested buyers and customers keep getting timely, on-brand follow-up.
Your pipeline becomes easier to inspect and manage even without a heavy platform.

ignore.title: Full autonomous customer promises
ignore.reason: Keep human approval on pricing, fulfillment timelines, wholesale terms, and final customer commitments.

ignore.title: Platform migration first
ignore.reason: Start by improving your current workflow. A new platform only makes sense after the manual booking and follow-up bottlenecks are measured.

ignore.title: Generic content volume
ignore.reason: The first win is response quality, booking, and routing, not flooding channels with unreviewed content.

ai_agents.name: Speed-to-Lead Inquiry Agent
ai_agents.desc: Responds to new product, support, or wholesale inquiries quickly and gathers the missing context before a human follow-up.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Speed-to-Lead Inquiry Agent for Capones USA. When a new inquiry arrives, classify whether it is a product order, support question, wholesale or retail request, or booking request. Draft a concise, on-brand reply that acknowledges the request, asks for the minimum missing context, and proposes the next step. Do not make pricing, fulfillment, or delivery promises. Route sensitive requests to Jorge's team for review.
ai_agents.outcome: New inquiries receive a useful response and a clear next step instead of waiting in the inbox.

ai_agents.name: Appointment Booking Agent
ai_agents.desc: Handles consultation and appointment requests by offering times, confirming, and sending reminders.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Appointment Booking Agent for Capones USA. When someone wants to book a consultation or appointment, confirm what they need, offer available times from the team's calendar, capture their contact details, and send a confirmation and reminder. Never double-book, never promise outcomes, and escalate anything unusual to a human. Keep the tone consistent with a premium grooming brand.
ai_agents.outcome: Booking requests get scheduled and confirmed without manual back-and-forth.

ai_agents.name: Lead Qualification Agent
ai_agents.desc: Scores inquiries by fit, urgency, intent, and required next action.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Lead Qualification Agent for Capones USA. Review an inquiry and summarize the intent, urgency, customer or buyer type, likely value, and recommended next action. If the inquiry is vague, ask two short clarifying questions. Do not invent product details or quote pricing. Keep the summary short enough to paste into a CRM or note.
ai_agents.outcome: You can prioritize the right conversations without reading every message from scratch.

ai_agents.name: Customer Support Triage Agent
ai_agents.desc: Sorts order and product support issues by type, urgency, missing evidence, and owner.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Customer Support Triage Agent for Capones USA. Read a support message and classify the issue type, urgency, affected order or product, missing details, likely owner, and a helpful first response. Ask for order numbers or details when needed. Do not promise refunds, replacements, or delivery dates without human review.
ai_agents.outcome: Order and product questions become easier to route and resolve.

ai_agents.name: Follow-Up Agent
ai_agents.desc: Drafts clean, on-brand follow-up for interested customers, retail buyers, and wholesale prospects.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the Follow-Up Agent for Capones USA. Draft a follow-up note after a customer or buyer conversation. Restate the interest, list the next two actions, name any needed approvals, and avoid committing to pricing, discounts, exclusivity, or delivery dates unless the team has approved them.
ai_agents.outcome: Interested buyers and customers keep getting timely, on-brand follow-up.

ai_agents.name: CRM Hygiene Agent
ai_agents.desc: Turns scattered conversations into notes, stage updates, and reminders even without a heavy platform.
ai_agents.agent_prompt: You are the CRM Hygiene Agent for Capones USA. Convert a messy email, chat, or message into a clean record with contact name, channel, intent, stage, open questions, promised follow-up, and next task date. Use neutral wording and flag any uncertainty instead of guessing.
ai_agents.outcome: Your pipeline becomes easier to inspect and manage.
